Connor — thanks for taking this. Also need to know whether Redwood will accept a limited-scope pen test or insists on full-surface testing.

Laura / Neha — can you weigh in on the following? I'm proposing we aim for a minimal set of commitments so NovusHealth's procurement can sign:

1) Pen-test language proposal (suggested compromise):
   - Default: testing on non-production environments only; production testing permitted only if explicitly defined in Order Form Appendix A with mutually agreed scope.
   - Notice: 48–72 hours with a stated test window and named control owners.
   - Access: ephemeral read-only credentials; no forensic-level access to live PHI-bearing systems without a separate addendum and on-site escort.

2) Evidence cadence proposal:
   - Quarterly snapshot artifacts: SOC2 mappings, selected log extracts (7 days surrounding sample events), system configuration snapshots, and KV-cache access summaries where relevant.
   - Delivery: encrypted bundle to NovusHealth security-designated mailbox; retention 90 days by default unless otherwise negotiated.

3) Order form mechanics: include an Appendix A (pen-test schedule & contact matrix) and Appendix B (evidence cadence matrix) that can be tailored per-customer without touching MSA core language.

Please review the attached redline and template — mark edits and return. I'm happy to drive a single consolidated redline back to Tom.

Connor

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Connor — reviewed and left in-line comments in LAURA_redline_security_exhibit_20260911.docx (attached). High-level legal positions and suggested language:

- Scope & Production: accept non-production as default; production testing permitted only with a narrow scope in Appendix A and explicit written consent. Add: "No Forensic Live-System Access" clause.
- Notice & Duration: 48–72 hours is acceptable provided we maintain explicit scheduling rights and the ability to revoke access for cause (security incidents).
- Data Handling & Redaction: require that any artifact containing customer-sensitive identifiers (PHI) be redacted prior to delivery; provide a sample redaction spec in Appendix B.
- Evidence Cadence: recommend naming the artifacts (config snapshot, auth logs, API rate-limits, KV cache summaries, SOC2 control mapping) and a maximum size/retention for delivered bundles. Quarterly cadence ok, but include right to request ad hoc evidence in case of incidents or audit triggers (reasonable scope & reimbursement clause).
- Insurance & Incident Response: add cross-reference to incident-response SLA and vendor insurance minimums in the Order Form.

Operational asks for Neha: please confirm whether ephemeral staging with read-only keys + named on-call is sufficient for your team to validate fixes. Also confirm whether we can commit to the "snapshot 7-day logs" ask without additional tooling.

Attachments: LAURA_redline_security_exhibit_20260911.docx (redline, put in Drive), comments summary included in the doc.

—Laura Bennett

Tom — thanks again for the clear requests and for your patience while we looped in legal and security. Summary of commitments we can accept (subject to DocuSign of the Order Form appendix):

- Pen test: default = non-production environments; production permitted only when Appendix A is completed and signed. Production access requires 48–72 hours notice, time-boxed window, ephemeral read-only creds, named control owners, and on-site escort for any forensic activity. "No Forensic Live-System Access" clause included by default.
- Evidence cadence: quarterly delivery of a prepared bundle (config snapshot, specified auth and access log extracts covering a 7-day window, SOC2 control mapping, and KV-cache access summaries where applicable). Bundles delivered encrypted to NovusHealth security mailbox; Redwood retains delivered artifacts for 90 days unless otherwise negotiated.
- Ad hoc requests: NovusHealth may request ad hoc artifacts for incident or audit triggers; scope limited to mutually agreed items and Redwood reserves right to charge for unusually broad extractions.
- Mechanics: we will add Appendix A (pen-test schedule & contact matrix) and Appendix B (evidence cadence, redaction spec, delivery mailbox) to the Order Form so the MSA remains stable across customers.

Attachments: LAURA_redline_security_exhibit_20260911.docx (legal redline), redline_security_exhibit_initial_20260911.docx, evidence_cadence_template_20260911.xlsx.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of this language by reply or mark edits in the attached redline. If accepted, we'll push the appendix into DocuSign and target signature in the 6-week review window you outlined. If you prefer a live call to finalize today/tomorrow, happy to schedule.

Thanks — cc'ing Laura and Neha so you have direct contacts for legal/ops on our side.
